site_name: CyrusOne Lewisville, Convergence Office Center, 2501 S State Hwy 121
serving_utility: Texas-New Mexico Power (TNMP), the wires company
notes: Verification pass, session 9, round 2 (D-58 rule 3, D-59 item 2). CyrusOne's release (Business Wire, on Yahoo's copy): 'a substantial upgrade to the utility infrastructure of its Lewisville, Texas data center ... raising the facility's total to 25 MVA of redundant utility capacity from Texas New Mexico Power (TNMP)', the facility being 'within the Convergence Technology Center'. The state's project record EABPRJA9809204 (tdlr.texas.gov) puts 'CYRUSONE LEWISVILLE - DATA HALL 5' at the Convergence Office Center, 2501 State Hwy. 121. TNMP is a wires company of ERCOT's competitive area and is outside the panel (D-4), so the site leaves Denton County Electric Cooperative, where the map had put it. Flagged: the statement is from 2013 and the parcel has since changed owner.
status_now: replaced by the record in batch_c_4.json, which rests on dated trade press; the republished release is a lead beside it
